units.title: 四级选词：指南针所指的北方
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Which North Does the Needle Mean?
materials.text:
In a classroom navigation exercise, a compass had a magnetised ____1____ that could turn freely. It responded to the Earth’s ____2____ field. The tutor distinguished the north associated with that field from ____3____ north, the direction towards the geographical pole.

The local angle between those directions was called ____4____. The class expressed the angle in ____5____, units dividing a full circle, rather than in metres. A map or instrument needed its stated reference understood before a number could describe a direction reliably.

From a marked observation point, students measured a ____6____ to a tower, the direction of that object relative to the chosen north. They held the instrument ____7____, flat rather than tilted upright, under the exercise’s instructions.

A reading near a large metal object was ____8____. The nearby object affected the field and the result no longer represented the intended reference in the same way. The instrument had been ____9____ through checks against an appropriate known reference, but that did not remove every later environmental interference.

Finally, students were asked to ____10____ a paper map until its marked direction matched the exercise’s agreed reference. They did not assume that every north arrow used the same convention. The lesson separated a physical pointer, an angular measurement and an interpretation of a map, so a confident number would not conceal an uncertain point of reference.

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: magnetised pointer turns freely为needle磁针。bearing方向角、grid网格、altitude高度都不是可转指针；其他词性或义不合。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: compass magnet response需magnetic磁场。true表地理真实北非场的性质，vertical垂直、level水平不命名磁现象，其他词不作该场种类定语。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: towards geographical pole定义true north真北。magnetic north已指磁场相关北且需区分，grid网格定向是另一参照，vertical/level不是地理极北名称。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: local angle magnetic与true north定义declination磁偏角。bearing目标方向、altitude高度、orientation泛取向都不特指两北差角。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: units full circle定义degrees度。bearing为所测方向量不是通用单位，metres文中被排，grid网格、needle指针不作角单位复数。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: from fixed point direction to object relative north定义bearing方位角。orientation泛朝向不能同样具体指该目标测量，altitude是高度或仰角而非水平目标方位；其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: flat rather tilted upright直接定义level水平。vertical是竖直反向，true真假、magnetic磁性不表示放平要求，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: nearby metal affected result说明distorted受扭曲。calibrated是参照核准而非这次干扰结果，magnetic说原理不是受干扰异常；其他词不作该过去分词。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: checks appropriate known reference指calibrated校准。distorted为偏曲不是依据参照核准，rotate为原形不能作had been后，其他词不表该检定操作。

questions.prompt: Which North Does the Needle Mean?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: map until direction matched要求rotate旋转。orientation是名词非to后动作，其他候选没有使图纸转向的原形动词；不是改变地理北本身。

units.title: 四级选词：簧片与管内空气的振动
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column
materials.text:
A music workshop introduced a simple ____1____, a thin strip that could bend and spring back. The demonstration example was made from ____2____, a plant material used for some instrument reeds. Its useful behaviour depended partly on being ____3____ rather than completely stiff.

The player’s ____4____ supplied moving air and energy. Repeated motion of the strip was an ____5____, a vibration rather than one permanent bend. The tutor then connected that motion with the air inside the instrument.

The enclosed air formed a ____6____ along the tube. Under suitable conditions, the strip and the air were ____7____, interacting so that neither could be described as entirely independent during the demonstration. A ____8____ response favoured particular patterns of vibration in the arrangement.

Opening or closing relevant ____9____ changed the effective acoustic conditions. These were holes placed in the instrument, not cracks added accidentally during use. The demonstration did not reduce every change to the player blowing harder.

Finally, the tutor discussed ____10____, the quality that can help distinguish two sounds even when they have a similar pitch and loudness. The reed, air and instrument all contributed. The class considered how the parts worked together instead of assuming that the visible vibrating strip alone explained the entire musical result.

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: thin bending springing strip为reed簧片。cane为其材料，column为空气柱，amplitude为振幅，其他名词非该发声薄片。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: plant material used reeds指cane芦竹类材料。breath气息、reed成品部件、column气柱不指此植物料；其他词义不合。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: rather completely stiff直接定义flexible柔韧。rigid为刚硬反义，resonant共振不等于能弯，fundamental基本的、sustained持续的均不说明柔性。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: player supplies moving air energy定义breath气息。cane材料、interval间隔、timbre音色、amplitude振幅不是演奏者送入空气的来源。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: repeated motion vibration rather permanent bend定义oscillation振荡。interval是间隔、amplitude幅度、timbre音质不指周期运动过程。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: enclosed air along tube定义column气柱。reed薄片、breath气息、apertures孔为复数，其他词不指管内连贯空气体。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: interacting neither independent定义coupled耦合。sustained持续不表相互作用，rigid刚性、fundamental基础都不说明两系统联动；其他词不作被动联接性质。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: favoured particular vibration patterns语境为resonant共振响应。rigid刚硬、flexible柔韧只材料性质，sustained持续不是选择模式机制，其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: holes placed instrument直接定义apertures开孔。interval间隔、column气柱、cane材料、reed薄片均非这里被开闭的复数孔。

questions.prompt: A Thin Reed, a Moving Column: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: quality distinguishes equal pitch loudness定义timbre音色。amplitude主要关联振幅强弱、interval音程或间隔、oscillation振动、column气柱均非该感知品质。

units.title: 四级选词：零件图中的正面与侧面
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: One Object, Several Views
materials.text:
A design class compared two ways to draw a small block. A ____1____ view made distance appear through converging directions, while an ____2____ drawing used views organised without that same visual convergence. The purpose of the second method was a dependable account of shape and measurement, not the appearance of a photograph.

The view from above was labelled the ____3____. A front or side ____4____ showed a different face. Students kept related features ____5____ across the views, positioned in corresponding lines rather than placed independently wherever space remained on the page.

A drawing’s ____6____ described the ratio between its depicted size and the object’s actual size. Written ____7____ supplied required measurements, because a printed copy could be resized. Measuring an altered print was not automatically equivalent to reading the specified values.

A ____8____ through the object revealed features that an outside view hid. The cut was an explanatory representation, not a claim that the actual block had arrived broken in two.

The outline of a surface was its ____9____. An added ____10____ could explain a material or a condition not clear from that outline alone. The class learned to connect views, measurements and notes. No single picture was expected to communicate every property simply because it looked convincing.

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: distance through converging directions定义perspective透视。orthographic为后文正投影对比，projection泛投影不特指这个会聚法，section剖面不表远近。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: without same visual convergence、views measurement定义orthographic正投影的。perspective已会聚，parallel虽相关但此处特指绘图系统非只平行性质；其他词不命名该方法。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: view from above直接定义plan平面图。elevation正立面或侧面、section剖视、contour轮廓不是该俯视名称；其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: front side view定义elevation立面图。plan俯视第3空占用，projection泛投影、annotation注释均不是此面视图名称。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: corresponding lines rather independently定义aligned对齐。distorted歪曲相反，horizontal/vertical仅方向不保证跨图对应，parallel只线向不等于特征位置对应。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: ratio drawing actual size定义scale比例。dimensions具体数值、projection投影、contour轮廓、annotation说明均非尺寸比关系。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: written required measurements定义dimensions尺寸。annotation泛注可含文字但并不直接命名所述量值，scale比例不是每项所需尺寸，其他词不指复数测量值。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: through object reveals hidden inside定义section剖面。contour外轮廓、elevation外视、plan俯视不特指假想切开显示内部的视图。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: outline surface直接定义contour轮廓。projection投影过程、annotation注解、scale比例、dimensions尺寸均非边界形状线。

questions.prompt: One Object, Several Views: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: added explains material condition定义annotation注记。contour只有形线，elevation视面、projection投射、section剖图不是额外文字说明。

units.title: 四级选词：滤材去除能力的范围
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: What Passed Through the Filter?
materials.text:
In a science demonstration, water passed through a ____1____ material containing many small spaces. The tutor introduced ____2____, a process in which certain substances were held on a surface. This was different from assuming the material simply swallowed everything that reached it.

The water could contain ____3____ particles that remained as separate pieces in the liquid. Other substances were ____4____, dispersed in solution rather than present as easily separated visible grains. One method of treatment did not necessarily remove both kinds equally.

The material had a limited ____5____ for the substances it could retain. Once that ability was ____6____, continued use would not guarantee the same result as at the beginning. The demonstration recorded when material was ____7____ with a fresh supply.

The speed of ____8____ through the arrangement also mattered to the stated test. The tutor kept the conditions named rather than treating every filter shape and use as equivalent.

The exercise measured selected ____9____, unwanted substances, under those conditions. It did not test every possible organism or chemical. Clear-looking water was therefore not automatically ____10____, free of living microorganisms. The tutor explicitly warned that a classroom observation of clarity or odour did not certify drinking safety. The lesson concerned interpreting a limited removal test, not providing a general method for making any water safe.

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: many small spaces定义porous多孔。transparent透明不说明孔隙，sterile无菌、certified认证都非材料几何结构；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: held on surface定义adsorption吸附。capacity容量、flow流动、texture质地、bacteria细菌不命名该表面附着过程。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: separate pieces liquid定义suspended悬浮。dissolved为溶解的对照，不是独立颗粒；exhausted耗尽、certified认证均不说明水中粒子状态。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: in solution not grains定义dissolved已溶解。suspended为悬浮粒，transparent是外观不等于成溶液，其他词不合该状态。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: limited ability retain定义capacity容量。texture质地不是可保有量，flow流速也不等于容纳能力，adsorption是过程非容量本身。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: once ability no longer same result定义exhausted耗尽。replaced是更换并非能力用完，certified认证、dissolved溶解都不作ability的此失能状态。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: with fresh supply明确replaced替换。exhausted只说耗尽不等于新料替入，dissolved溶解改变材料非换新；其他候选无该更换过去分词。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: speed through arrangement定义flow流动。capacity能力、adsorption附着、texture质地均不指水通系统的运动，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: unwanted substances定义contaminants污染物。bacteria只是可能部分微生物且本段不测试所有，capacity/texture/flow不是所测外来物质总类。

questions.prompt: What Passed Through the Filter?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: free living microorganisms直接定义sterile无菌。transparent透明只说明视觉，certified是获证非无菌性质，upstream位置、porous孔隙均不保证无活微生物。

units.title: 四级选词：站台排队与上下车通道
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Leaving Room at the Door
materials.text:
A fictional station trial marked waiting areas beside a train door. Passengers formed a ____1____, an ordered waiting line, in the space provided. The central route was kept available for people leaving the carriage.

The station called getting on ____2____ and getting off ____3____. The two activities could not be understood merely by counting everyone standing near a door. A person waiting to enter was in a different stage from someone trying to leave.

When both groups moved ____4____ into the same narrow space, at the same time, their paths could interfere. A suitcase left across the middle ____5____ the route, blocking movement even without an increase in passenger numbers.

The trial used ____6____ areas, places specified by the station rather than chosen independently by every group. Its information also explained which passengers had ____7____ under the stated assistance arrangement, the right to be served before others in that context.

The team observed ____8____, crowding that slowed movement, rather than assume a long line was necessarily moving badly. A long line could advance regularly, while a small group could remain ____9____ without moving at all.

After the train left, waiting passengers ____10____ across the platform towards their destinations. They spread out instead of remaining as one dense group at the former doorway. The report named the period and action measured. A photograph of a crowd could not by itself reveal whether people were waiting, entering, leaving or simply pausing.

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: ordered waiting line定义queue队伍。flow是运动、congestion拥挤、capacity容量不等有序候车线，dwell停站期、platform站台都不是队伍。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: getting on定义boarding上车。alighting为下车、exit离开、dwell是停站时段非登车动作，boarding是明确行为名称。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: getting off定义alighting下车。boarding相反，platform为站台，direction方向、flow流动不具体命名下车动作。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: at same time直接定义simultaneously同时。其他候选无表示同步发生的方式副词，stationary为静止反义而非同时副词。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: blocking movement定义obstructed阻挡。dispersed分散相反，designated指定不会以suitcase为主语表示物理挡路，其他词不合过去式动作。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: places specified station定义designated指定。stationary静止、obstructed受堵、dispersed散开均不表达经站方划定的资格。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: right served before others定义priority优先。capacity容量、direction方向、platform站台、queue排队并不等于先接受协助的权利。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: crowding slowed movement定义congestion拥堵。capacity可承载量、queue队伍不必拥堵、flow流动不是拥挤造成的迟缓状态。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: without moving at all定义stationary静止。designated划定、dispersed散开、obstructed受挡不等同身体完全不动的状态；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: Leaving Room at the Door: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: spread out not one dense group定义dispersed散开。obstructed阻挡、designated指定不能表示人群铺散动作，其他项非该过去时谓语。

units.title: 四级选词：分组数据中的平均与中位
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Number in the Middle
materials.text:
A class recorded how long a group of fictional journeys took. The collected cases formed a ____1____, a set used to study the question rather than every journey that could ever occur. Students first put the times in an ____2____ list, from shortest to longest.

With an odd number of entries, the ____3____ was the middle value in that ordering. The arithmetic ____4____ used the total divided by the number of cases. The two summaries could differ, especially if one unusually long journey pulled the latter upwards.

Such an ____5____ value lay far from most of the others. It did not automatically mean a recording error. The class checked the case before deciding whether it belonged in the analysis.

For a histogram, times were placed into ____6____, groups covering stated spans. The ____7____ of each group was the number of cases it contained. Changing a boundary could change the visible shape, so the group intervals were labelled.

The overall ____8____ showed how values were spread, rather than only one central number. A long tail on one side could make the shape ____9____, not balanced evenly around its centre. Finally, the ____10____ stated the distance between the smallest and largest recorded values. The class kept these ideas separate: one convenient summary did not preserve every feature of the journeys behind it.

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: set studied not every journey定义sample样本。range为极差、distribution分布、frequency频数、interval区间都不是这批观测案例集合角色。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: shortest longest明确ordered排好序。uniform均匀不等于排序，skewed偏态为分布形状、categorical类别属性均不说明列表排序。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: middle value ordering定义median中位数。mode众数最常见不必中间，average此处后定义算术均值，range极差非中心位置。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: total divided count定义arithmetic average算术平均。median按排序、mode按出现次数、range最大最小差均非该算法。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: far from most others定义extreme极端。skewed描述整体分布，uniform均匀、categorical类别都不直接说明单个远离多数的数值。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: histogram groups stated spans定义bins分箱。interval泛区间为单数不接复数groups位置，frequency计数、range总体跨度不是每个分组容器。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: number cases group定义frequency频数。mode最常见值、median中位数、range极差不等于该箱内人数计数，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: how values spread定义distribution分布。average一个中心数、sample案例集合、range端点差均不完整指各值散布情况。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: long tail one side not balanced定义skewed偏态。uniform各处均匀相反，ordered只排序、categorical类别非连续时间形状，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: The Number in the Middle: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: distance smallest largest定义range极差。interval可泛时段但这里专指两极端之差，median中心、mode众数、frequency频数均不合。

units.title: 六级选词：研究数据开放中的时间与权限
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?
materials.text:
A fictional research team deposited a collection in a ____1____, a service responsible for storing and providing a route to research material. The public record contained ____2____ describing the collection, such as its title, creators and scope. This descriptive information could be visible even where the files were not freely downloadable.

Some files remained under an ____3____ until a stated release date. Others were ____4____ because their content required an approved access process, not merely a wait for time to pass. The team distinguished a temporary delay from a continuing condition on use.

Participants’ ____5____ covered specified uses of their contributions. Removing obvious names did not automatically create permission for everything else. Even files described as ____6____ could contain patterns or combinations that allowed identification, so the team examined the basis of that description.

The public ____7____ stated permissions and conditions for material the team was entitled to release. A download link alone was not a substitute for these terms. Required ____8____ identified creators or sources; it did not imply that every later interpretation had been approved by them.

Files were ____9____ so that a citation could identify the state of the collection actually used. Corrections did not silently turn an earlier reference into a reference to changed data. The record also described ____10____, the origin and transformations through which the material had reached its present form.

The team wanted the collection to support further work without treating openness as one switch. Discovery, download, lawful use and interpretation involved related but different questions. Naming those questions made the release more useful than a general claim that the data had been put online.

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: service stores provides route research material定义repository储存库。catalogue目录是描述列表不一定存文件，access权限、retention保留安排不指托管服务。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: title creators scope descriptive info定义metadata元数据。provenance专指源流不包全部标题范围，catalogue整体目录、license授权不等于单集描述数据。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: until stated release date明确embargo限时禁发。restricted为形容词且不接an表示时期，retention保留期不等于禁访问期限，consent是同意不是延期状态。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: approved access not just time定义restricted受限。anonymised是处理身份不等于获准门槛，versioned分版本、reusable可复用不说明持续审批访问。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: participants specified permitted uses指consent同意。license团队对可授权数据条款不等参与者同意，attribution署名、access访问均非本人许可原始贡献用途。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: removing names but pattern identification讨论anonymised匿名化。sensitive敏感不指做过身份处理，restricted访问受限不等匿名，versioned版本管理也不涉及去识别。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: permissions conditions released material定义license许可。catalogue目录、metadata元数据、retention保留期不提供可用授权条款，其他名词不合。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: identified creators sources定义attribution署名归属。consent同意、provenance源流、access访问均不直接等于复用时鸣谢原作者的要求。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: citation identifies state corrections linked说明versioned分版本。anonymised去识别、restricted受限、reusable可复用不保证旧引用所指版本被保留。

questions.prompt: A Dataset Is Listed, but Is It Open?: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: origin transformations reaching present form定义provenance源流。metadata泛描述、catalogue目录、license许可不特指产生转化历史。

units.title: 六级选词：表达数据中的计数与技术批次
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation
materials.text:
A fictional data-analysis lesson compared measurements used to study gene ____1____, the activity reflected in the production of RNA under the exercise’s model. The table contained ____2____, numbers of recorded observations assigned to features, not a direct inventory of every molecule in each cell.

The observations came from ____3____, a process that generated readable molecular information. The relationship between its output and biological ____4____ required interpretation. More recorded observations could reflect a greater amount of a target, but also differences in the total material observed or the procedure.

Some comparisons were ____5____: they concerned a feature’s share in a sample rather than an independently established absolute number. The data were ____6____ under a stated method to make relevant comparisons more meaningful. This adjustment did not create information about every source of difference or guarantee that all assumptions were satisfied.

The analysts distinguished biological variation from ____7____ effects produced by measurement and processing. Samples prepared together belonged to a recorded ____8____. If every treated sample was processed in one group and every comparison sample in another, the intended contrast could be ____9____, mixed with the processing difference.

Additional ____10____ were used to examine variation across repeated appropriate samples. Their role depended on how they were obtained; copying one file several times did not create new biological observations. The report named the design and transformations so that a precise-looking table would not be mistaken for a complete explanation of why the values differed.

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: activity reflected RNA production defines gene expression表达。abundance为丰度量、sequencing为读序过程、variance变异度不等于该活动概念。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: numbers recorded observations定义counts计数。replicates为重复样本而非每格观测数，variance为变异指标、threshold阈值不等于原始次数。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: process generates readable molecular info定义sequencing测序。expression是活动本身，normalised为分词，reference参照、abundance丰度不是该读取过程。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: greater amount target对应abundance丰度。variance是分散、threshold界值、batch批次、reference参照均非目标存在数量多少。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: share rather absolute直接定义relative相对的。technical技术性质不说明比率口径，withheld隐去、confounded混杂均不指相对份额。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: adjustment stated method comparison说明normalised归一化。withheld为隐去不等于调整，confounded为混杂问题而非为了可比的处理，其他候选不表该操作。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: produced measurement processing定义technical技术性影响。relative说明相对口径不指来源，reference作参照名词、variance为统计量均非与生物变化对照的测量来源性质。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: prepared together recorded group定义batch批次。reference为参照、threshold阈值、variance变异量不命名共同制备组。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: mixed treatment with processing difference定义confounded混杂。normalised调整不保证解开此纠缠，withheld隐去不说明原因不可区分；其他词不合。

questions.prompt: A Larger Count, a Different Explanation: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: repeated appropriate samples定义replicates重复样本。counts是每样本计数不能用作新独立生物观测，reference参照、variance变异并非多个样本。

units.title: 六级选词：时间指示与动作的内部结构
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: When the Story’s Now Moved
materials.text:
A fictional grammar seminar distinguished ____1____, locating a situation relative to a time point, from ____2____, presenting its internal temporal structure. The contrast helped students explain why two sentences about the past could describe an event in different ways.

The ____3____ point was not always the moment of writing. A narrative could establish a later past moment and describe what had already happened before it. The form used to present an activity as in progress was labelled ____4____ in the exercise.

A past ____5____ construction placed one situation before the established past point. The students did not treat every earlier action as necessarily finished forever; they examined what the particular construction and context supported.

An account of repeated ordinary activity could be ____6____, describing a practice rather than one unique occurrence. The distinction did not come only from the date on the page. The sentence and its surrounding context mattered.

Words such as here and tomorrow were ____7____ expressions, interpreted through a viewpoint and a situation of speaking. In ____8____ speech, an account of someone else’s words, those references could require explanation rather than mechanical copying.

The resulting ____9____ of events was the order a reader could establish from the account. It was not identical to the order in which every sentence appeared. Some relationships remained an ____10____, a conclusion drawn from context rather than directly marked by a verb form.

The seminar used explicit examples in discussion but kept its definitions separate. A grammatical label identified a feature to examine; it did not settle every temporal relationship a longer story might invite a reader to understand.

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: locating situation relative time定义tense时态。aspect是内部呈现方式后对照，duration是持续长度、sequence为事件次序不指动词定位范畴。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: internal temporal structure定义aspect体。tense外部时间定位不同，punctuation标点、discourse语篇、duration时长不等于该语法呈现范畴。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: point established time锚定reference point参照点。duration长度、punctuation标点、discourse语篇不形成此处时间锚术语，其他词不合。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: activity in progress明确定义progressive进行体。perfect是完成式前先关系另述，habitual习惯反复非此刻展开，anterior早于、simultaneous同时不命名进行形式。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: past perfect construction对应过去参照前事件。progressive进行、habitual习惯、reported转述均不是past perfect这种已述先后构式名称。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: repeated ordinary practice not unique定义habitual习惯性的。simultaneous同时、anterior在前、deictic指示性都不表达反复惯常。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: here tomorrow interpreted viewpoint situation定义deictic指示的。reported转述、habitual习惯、anterior先于不说明依说话情境指向。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: account someone else words直接定义reported speech间接转述。progressive语法体、deictic指示性、simultaneous同时均非该言语呈现方式。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: order events defined sequence次序。duration时长不是先后，discourse语篇可非时序，punctuation标点不指事件排列关系。

questions.prompt: When the Story’s Now Moved: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: conclusion context rather explicit verb mark定义inference推论。reference为参照、duration时长、punctuation符号、sequence顺序本身均非读者推得的认识过程结果。

units.title: 六级选词：模块设计中的接口与维护
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Replacing One Part of the System
materials.text:
A fictional engineering project divided a system into ____1____, parts with identified roles. The parts communicated through ____2____, defined boundaries describing what could pass between them. Merely drawing boxes around code or machinery did not establish that the boundaries worked as intended.

A ____3____ stated the required behaviour against which tests would be interpreted. A new part was ____4____ with the rest only if the relevant expectations could be satisfied together, not simply because it had the same outward shape.

The design was described as ____5____ when its parts could be understood and changed within defined boundaries. The team examined ____6____, the degree to which parts depended on one another. A change intended to be local could spread if those dependencies had been hidden.

Within a part, ____7____ concerned how closely its responsibilities belonged together. Grouping unrelated duties merely because they fit in the same container could make later understanding more difficult. Separating everything into the smallest possible piece was not automatically the best solution either.

When a part failed, the team wanted to ____8____ it without redesigning every neighbour. It also needed to ____9____ the fault, identify its cause, rather than swap pieces blindly until the symptom happened to disappear.

A ____10____ system was one that could be cared for and changed under the stated practical conditions. That depended on records, skills and access as well as structure. The project did not equate a fashionable design label with a guarantee. It tested whether the chosen boundaries supported the actual work people would later need to perform.

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: parts identified roles定义components组件。interfaces为组件间界面不是部件本身，inventory清单、redundancy冗余不是被划分的功能部件。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: defined communication boundaries定义interfaces接口。components是两端部件，specification要求文书、inventory清单不等于沟通边界本身。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: required behaviour tests against定义specification规格。inventory只是清单，cohesion内聚、coupling耦合是设计属性，不能代替要求行为的正式说明。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: expectations satisfied together定义compatible兼容。standardised标准化不保证能共满足，transparent透明、obsolete过时、modular模块化都不等于此关系。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: parts understood changed defined boundaries定义modular模块化。standardised只符合标准、transparent信息可见、obsolete过时、maintainable可维护均不是具体分模块结构名称。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: degree parts depend each other定义coupling耦合。cohesion为部件内部责任关联，不是部件间依赖，redundancy冗余、inventory清单不合。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: within part responsibilities closely belong定义cohesion内聚。coupling部件间关系相反，redundancy重复备份、specification规格、inventory列物不指内部职责相合程度。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: failed part without redesign neighbours要求replace替换。diagnose为找原因不是换部件，其他候选不作to后的这种更换原形动词。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: identify cause rather swap blindly定义diagnose诊断。replace为更换不自动查因，其他候选非这个原形动作。

questions.prompt: Replacing One Part of the System: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: could cared changed practical conditions定义maintainable可维护。modular是结构不保证技能访问等维护条件，transparent可见、standardised有标准、obsolete旧都不等于可维持改进。

units.title: 六级选词：概率更新中的先验与证据
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions
materials.text:
A fictional forecasting seminar began with a ____1____ distribution, the representation of uncertainty used before the new observations were considered. It was not treated as knowledge obtained from those same observations. The analysts then described the ____2____ that the new data could provide.

The ____3____ expressed how the observed data related to candidate hypotheses under the stated model. The relevant probabilities were ____4____ on those hypotheses and other model conditions; their meaning depended on what had been assumed, not only on the visible numbers.

Combining the starting distribution with the new information produced a ____5____ distribution. The process allowed the team to ____6____ its beliefs rather than freeze the first judgement permanently. A revised result still inherited important features of the procedure that produced it.

The report named its ____7____, including choices about how observations were generated. An impressive calculation could not make an unsupported model correct merely by carrying it out accurately. The team therefore conducted a ____8____ analysis, varying reasonable starting choices to see how much the conclusions changed.

A result was described as ____9____ within that examined range if the central conclusion persisted despite those changes. This did not establish immunity to every possible untested model. Finally, the forecasts were checked for being ____10____: across appropriate repeated cases, events assigned a given probability should occur at a corresponding frequency under the stated assessment.

No single successful prediction settled that long-run question. The exercise connected updating, model dependence and later checking, rather than use the word probability as a general certificate of certainty.

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: before new observations考虑的分布定义prior先验。posterior是结合新数据后，forecast为预测、likelihood数据条件关系不等于初始信念分布。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: new data provide relevant information即evidence证据。weights数值权重、forecast未来陈述、assumptions模型前提都不是新数据自身提供的支持。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: observed data relation candidate hypotheses under model定义likelihood似然。prior初始、posterior更新后分布、forecast预测均不是这项固定数据对候选假设的关联函数。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: on hypotheses model conditions直接定义conditional有条件的。independent独立与这里depends on已给条件不同，uniform均匀、calibrated校准不表达条件限定。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: combining prior new information defines posterior后验。prior是更新前且第1空锁定，likelihood是数据关系而非合成后的信念分布，其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: revise beliefs rather freeze要求update更新。discard丢弃不等于保起点并合新证据，其他词不作to后此动态修正原形动词。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: choices how observations generated为assumptions假设。weights是可能参数非全部前提，evidence数据支持不同于生成假定，forecast未来结果不是前提。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: vary starting choices conclusions change定义sensitivity敏感性。likelihood、prior或posterior各为模型量不等于该变化范围检查，其他项不合术语。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: central conclusion persisted despite tested changes定义robust稳健。uniform均匀、independent独立、conditional有条件不直接表示对检过扰动稳定。

questions.prompt: Changing a Belief Without Losing Its Assumptions: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: repeated frequency matches assigned probability定义calibrated经概率校准的。robust抗假设变动不同于频率对应，uniform分布均一、independent独立不保证预测频率校准。

units.title: 六级选词：拥堵收费中的成本与负担
units.instruction: Read the complete passage. Choose an unchanged word from the shared fifteen-word bank for each gap. Each word may be used at most once; five are not needed.

materials.title: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill
materials.text:
A fictional economics class examined an extra car journey in a crowded district. The traveller considered a ____1____ cost, borne directly by the decision-maker, such as fuel and a parking payment. The trip might also impose delays on other road users.

An unpriced effect on others was an ____2____ in the model. The additional cost associated with one more journey was described as ____3____, rather than the average cost of all journeys already made. Under crowded conditions, the relevant effect included ____4____, interference among vehicles that slowed their movement.

A fee could create an ____5____ to change behaviour by altering the price the traveller faced. The class considered demand ____6____, how strongly the quantity of trips responded to a specified price change. The response was not assumed identical for every person or time.

Switching to another available travel mode was one form of ____7____. Whether this option existed depended on actual alternatives, not simply on a diagram showing that a price had risen. Some people could change plans more easily than others.

The ____8____ of the policy concerned who ultimately bore its economic burden. The person making the direct payment was not necessarily the only person affected; costs could alter delivery charges or other prices. Total money collected by the authority was its ____9____, a different quantity from the net social effect.

A judgement about ____10____ considered benefits and costs to people under stated values and assumptions. Collecting more money did not automatically establish a larger social improvement. The exercise separated behavioural response, payment and the distribution of consequences rather than claim one fee was best for every district.

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 1.
questions.explanation: borne directly decision-maker定义private私人成本。marginal额外一单位不等于自己承受，transparent透明、other nouns不说明直接承担主体属性。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 2.
questions.explanation: unpriced effect others定义externality外部性。subsidy补贴、transfer转移支付、scarcity稀缺不等于未计价的他人影响；其他候选不合。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 3.
questions.explanation: additional one more rather average定义marginal边际。private只说承担者，transparent可见性不说额外一单位，其他项词性不合。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 4.
questions.explanation: vehicles interference slow movement定义congestion拥堵。scarcity稀缺一般不一定车辆相互迟缓，elasticity反应程度、incidence负担归宿非交通状态。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 5.
questions.explanation: price change motivation behaviour定义incentive激励。subsidy为补贴而此处是收费改变代价，并非费用自动创造补贴；revenue为收入，不能替代个体行为动机。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 6.
questions.explanation: quantity response specified price change定义elasticity弹性。incidence负担归属、welfare社会福祉、congestion拥堵都不测需求对价格反应程度。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 7.
questions.explanation: switch another mode定义substitution替代。transfer可能换乘或支付转移但这里是需求选择另一替代品，offset抵销、scarcity稀缺不指这种替代行为。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 8.
questions.explanation: who ultimately bears burden定义incidence归宿。revenue收款不说明负担转嫁，externality为对外效应非此政策成本最终承担者，其他项不合。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 9.
questions.explanation: total money authority collected定义revenue收入。welfare为人群净福祉非收款，transfer只是资金转移动作、subsidy是补贴支出，均非此所得总额名。

questions.prompt: The Cost Not Shown on the Driver’s Bill: choose the unchanged bank word for gap 10.
questions.explanation: benefits costs people values defines welfare福祉。revenue金钱收入不等社会改善，scarcity稀缺、congestion交通状态、incidence归宿都不是整体效用评价。
